competitors.name: Miro

pricing.free_tier: 3 editable boards, low-res export w/ watermark

strengths: advanced sharing permissions on paid tiers
weaknesses: Free plan: 3 boards, low-res watermarked export, view-only visitors
no CSV export on mobile/tablet, no PPT/PNG/SVG native export

competitors.name: FigJam

pricing.free_tier: 3 FigJam files, full export, Open Session 24h anon edit

strengths: Open Session: 24h password-protected anon edit, no signup
free tier exports PNG/JPG/PDF/CSV without watermark
weaknesses: lighter feature set (no advanced diagramming, no Gantt/PM)
Open Session cannot use audio/comments with visitors

competitors.name: Mural

pricing.free_tier: 3 murals, unlimited members+visitors, facilitation tools free

strengths: unlimited visitors on all plans, visitor display-name gate
CSV bulk email import, embed code + ZIP/HTML export
weaknesses: export is async (email link, 5-15 min) not instant
no native CSV export of sticky/table text
customer support cited as slow, mobile bugs
visitors cannot be invited via email (link only)
